Candidate: "A Winter Among the Pamirs" (fictional, written for the test harness).

A travel narrative by an invented English officer who crossed the Pamir range in
1894 on the way to Kashgar, with notes on the Kirghiz herders he met, the
caravan routes and the weather. First published in London in 1896; the author
died in 1911, so the text is out of copyright. A scanned copy exists in a public
digital library. The imprint has not published this author before.
